rejection_summary.title: The Frame
rejection_summary.reason: Rejected after whole-runtime evidence review: strong reality-collision premise and escalating impossible-world imagery, but the 127-minute story is primarily metaphysical/fantasy-romance, with little scientific investigation or testable rule discovery and a deliberately symbolic execution/payoff that does not safely support an 82+ baseline score.

Rejected after whole-runtime evidence review: appealing motel-floor time portal and paradox mechanics, but evidence describes a thin, predictable treatment with a slow start, limited exploration of the time-travel system and distracting police subplot; insufficient sustained investigation/concept escalation for an 82+ baseline score.
